correctness.rationale: The frozen specialized statement for h=2, stated without an n>h restriction, omits the distinct reversal pairs at length 2. For example, 01 and 10 both occur since the whole two-letter language is realized. The replacement explicitly gives the exact set of even n with 2≤n≤p+3 and proves the short contribution q(q−1)/2. The universal formulas do not change. Bi-infinite recurrence independently on h residues gives unique lifts for arbitrary initials and any admitted base factor. Reversal sends the difference word v to −v^R; for q≥3 the binary residues and their negatives intersect only at 0, so exactly the zero-difference fibers are reversible at n>h. The fixed labels solve 2j≡n−1 mod h, so f_h(n) fixed residues give (h+f_h(n))/2 free labels for palindromes; each remaining 2-cycle removes one count. Below and at h the entire language is available. The noble-means gaps p,p+1 follow by inflating successive zeros separated by zero or one intervening 1; both preimage patterns 00 and 010 occur. This gives the advertised all-length cutoffs and example. The strictly ergodic case is credited specifically to Kang–Jäger v2 Thm. 1.6 with κ=q and ℓ=h+1; the proof-range seam at p=1 is recorded as an auxiliary source risk, independent of the transfer proof. The unchanged finite checker covers the short lengths and was inspected, not executed.
